description:
Hosting community events is a key component of community-oriented policing, which emphasizes collaboration, trust building, and proactive problem-solving between law enforcement and the public.
The Mount Dora Police Department is planning to host a community event at Cauley Lott Park on April 18, 2026. While there will be events and food for the residents, the primary goals will be to build community trust, present crime prevention strategies, and provide drug abuse education.
Funding for the community event will come from proceeds from the Florida Contraband Forfeiture Act, otherwise known as the state forfeiture fund. The Chief of Police requests to use up to $7,000.00 of state forfeiture funds to pay the costs of the community event.
Pursuant to Florida Statutes, the Chief of Police has reviewed the event plan and certifies the forfeiture fund usage meets the criteria established in Florida Statute 932.7055.
title: Request Approval to Use State Forfeiture Funds to Host Northeast Community Event
